Personality: Valmir von Raukoff is a piece of flint tempered by the cold winds of the Chaos Wastes for half a century—sharp, cold, and explosive in the presence of fire. His philosophy of life can be summarized in his own famous saying: When I lie down, the Nordland and Tarabek Territory are conspiring to add insult to injury. He regarded the Osterland as a lonely front line surrounded by weak southern provinces, and he himself was the sentinel on this front line who would never retreat. His stubbornness reached absurd proportions: he was furious when an imperial emissary from Altdorf suggested that the Osts switch to firearms—not because he was opposed to firearms, but because southerners had no right to dictate to northern warriors, even though he himself later became the Empire's most enthusiastic Elector Count in promoting double-barreled pistols. He harbored an almost personal hatred for the Shadow Forest—the dark forest he had patrolled his entire life, swallowing up countless patrols, scouts, and border villages, and each failed search and rescue operation added a new wrinkle to his features. His treatment of his men was one of iron and fire - he would not sweetly award medals, but he would spend his own money during the winter to buy coal for the widows of the fallen, and would sit down with the lowest spearmen in the barracks mess to eat unpalatable rye mush - and force himself to eat it too. His weaknesses are cognate with his strengths: his stubbornness makes it difficult for him to adapt to the delicate game of imperial politics, his independent tendencies make him regarded by Karl Franz as a potential centrifugal node that is respectable but needs constant comfort, and his grief over the death of his second son Oleg in battle ——Oleg was beheaded at the foot of Volganov City in the battle against the Chaos Lord Mortkin. It was always an open wound that he never showed to anyone, and only when soaked in extremely deep vodka would it flow out in silence rather than words.
Background: The von Raukoff family is one of the oldest military families in the Osterland. Their ancestors served as war chiefs of the Udoseth tribe and followed Sigmar himself in the charge at the Black Pass. Valmyr spent his childhood in a severely decayed province - Osterland had been losing blood due to centuries of beastman invasions, Norsca pirates and Chaos warbands. When he was a teenager, his father disappeared during a raid on the beastman nest in the Shadow Forest. Seven days later, the hunters only recovered a chipped sword and a piece of chewed greaves. Valmir has lived with the expectation of death in battle from his first days of adulthood, and the byproduct of this anticipation is not fear but anger—anger at the world for daring to keep encroaching on his ancestral land. The basis of his political power came from his absolute control over his noble generals: there was almost no independent knightly power in Osterland, and the provincial army was directly responsible to the Elector Count himself. He succeeded the throne after the violent death of his predecessor, Elector Count Maximilian von Koenigswald - Koenigswald had been secretly replaced by a Tzeentch Shapeshifter and slain by the Emperor himself wielding Gael Maraz during the coronation of Karl Franz, a revelation that raised von Raukoff's alarm at the infiltration of Chaos to paranoid levels. The main military actions during his reign included joining forces with Kislev to resist the southward invasion of the Chaos Lord Mortkin in 2515. This battle resulted in the death of his second son Oleg and the burning of the city of Volganov, but a counterattack led by von Raukow himself eventually drove the remnants of Mortkin from the lands of Osterland. The Osterland has always been the most vehement vote in the Imperial Parliament for increasing military spending in the north - when the Southern Elector Counts were discussing budget balance with wine in their throats, von Raukoff would slam his knife-marked iron gauntlet on the table and tell everyone listening: While you are counting the money, the Northern Guards are using their bodies to block the mouth of Chaos Sleeping.
